chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: How many a person exhausts himself yet livelihood is scarce for him, and how many a moderate seeker is assisted by the divine decrees.

key_terms.الْمَقَادِيرُ: Divine decrees/destinies — the ordained measures of provision allocated by God
key_terms.مُقْتَرٍ: Scarce/straitened — one whose provision has been divinely restricted despite effort
key_terms.مُقْتَصِدٍ: Moderate in seeking — one who neither over-exerts nor is negligent

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about working hard and earning a livelihood?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights a profound spiritual truth about livelihood and divine decree (qadar): excessive striving does not guarantee abundance, while moderation combined with trust in God's plan (tawakkul) often yields divine assistance. This teaching was directed at a culture that prized relentless pursuit of wealth, redirecting attention toward the role of divine predestination in distributing sustenance.
